newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SPH exercises buy option for Paragon.
newsitem.headline: SPH exercises buy option for Paragon.

text.p: Media group Singapore Press Holdings (SPH) said on Friday that it had exercised its option to buy Sogo's Paragon building on Orchard Road, Singapore's prime shopping belt.

Orchard 290 Pte Ltd, a joint venture company leading the acquisition, had given a deposit of Singapore $96.75 million to Tararone Investments Pte Ltd for the S$682.3 million acquisition, SPH said in a statement.
The acquisition would be completed on July 7, 1997, on which date the balance of the amount would be payable, it added.
SPH through wholly-owned subsidiary, Times Properties Pte Ltd, has a 75 percent shareholding in Orchard 290 while Lum Chang Holdings 20 percent, and SC Global Investments Pte Ltd five percent.
